text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Satsuki Sho. The first step toward 
the Classic Triple Crown that Fuji Kiseki 
could not take—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket finally takes her first step 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san... I've made it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days prior, there was something I 
desperately wanted to confirm, so I paid a 
visit to a certain person.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
A comparison between Fuji Kiseki and 
Jungle Pocket as they are right now?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I figured you'd understand, bro.
Yeah, I figured you'd understand, bro

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki back when they called her a 
guaranteed Triple Crown winner, and Jungle 
Pocket now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My brother was the only one who could 
truly measure just how wide that gap was.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Putting everything together with 
what you've told me and comparing the two, 
honestly speaking...

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
I think there's a difference in their 
level of polish. As of right now, Fuji 
Kiseki has the edge.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki back then was quite solid, 
both physically and mentally, with no 
causes for concern. But...

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket is still just a kid. She has 
raw power, but physical vulnerabilities 
are visible throughout.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text: This is my view on the matter.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this feeling is wild...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
My heart's pounding hard enough to burst 
through the ceiling. So this is the 
Classic Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I have to do it. But with my strength, 
just how far can I go...
choice_data_list: Pokke, honestly, your body is still weak.

Pokke, to be honest, your body is still 
weak.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
W-What's that all of a sudden? You saying 
that's why I can't win?
choice_data_list:
However, your constitution isn't weak. 
Your latent strength is boundless!

Still, your constitution isn't weak. Your 
latent strength is boundless!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Infinity...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Big Bro pointed out was true. 
However, completely separate from that, 
there was conviction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is still developing. Jungle Pocket is 
growing stronger with every passing 
moment.
choice_data_list: I believe in you—in your wild instincts!
I believe in your wild instincts!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's right, partner. I knew it, 
you're the one person who's always, 
absolutely on my side.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yo, Tachyon. How're you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My condition? Regardless of how that is, I 
will show you my full power today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This is our big stage. —Right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Damn right. Today, on this stage, I'm 
gonna avenge Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (No matter who Fuji-san has her hopes on.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, go ahead and run. Your motive? 
Anything will do! Any catalyst is fine by 
me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"And carve that light into your eyes. For 
that is your guiding beacon."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan, I'm here too! I don't plan on 
losing either!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Dants. Make sure you don't have any 
regrets either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she said that, Jungle Pocket had 
eyes only for Agnes Tachyon. And 
understandably so.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, Pokke-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke... Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no joy on Fuji Kiseki's face. If 
anything, she seemed troubled by 
something...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Nakayama Racecourse. Right-handed turns, 
my weakness, and I can't use a long 
sustained burst of speed either. But...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I'll show you, Tachyon. The run—of my 
very soul!)
